source_review.excerpt: The Decisions API is now generally available with gpt-6-luna.
source_review.decision: October 22 changelog and GA guide reviewed, including JSON evidence, per-question images, caching, question limits, supported model and evaluation guidance.
source_review.availability: Generally available with gpt-6-luna; API access, billing and regional conditions apply.

openai.reason: The October 22 GA materially extends the October 6 beta with structured JSON input, per-question images, shared-input caching and up to 400 questions.

anthropic.reason: The October 22 Anthropic-managed Google Cloud launch is useful but needs a separate IAM, billing and organization-boundary briefing.

google.reason: The newest Gemini API entry remains the October 13 Gemini 4 Argon availability change, already covered by episode 2026-10-15-gemini-argon-api.

repositories.reason: MCP reference-server v2.1.0 was covered and published earlier today in 2026-10-26-mcp-security-update; no duplicate.

architectures.reason: SPECMEM is a research-only live tool-call memory architecture whose mechanism and evidence require a dedicated Deep review.

editorial_review.context: builder / builder / daily; OpenAI Decisions API GA; event date 2026-10-22
editorial_review.viewer_question: What should a builder change when moving a Decisions API evaluation from the October beta to GA?
editorial_review.prerequisites: OpenAI API access, a beta Decisions integration or evaluation plan, and labeled examples from the target workflow.
editorial_review.central_task: Send ticket and order records as structured JSON evidence, keep typed questions separate, and recalibrate review thresholds before enabling actions.
editorial_review.new_capability: GA adds input_json, per-question images, shared-input caching, conversation history and up to 400 questions, twice the beta limit.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: All 20 episode files and confirmed receipts checked. Episode 2026-10-08-decisions-routing covered the beta request and refusal-aware routing evaluation, not the October 22 GA input and scale changes.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: Builders can migrate without stringifying structured records, group independent checks over shared evidence and review cache and threshold behavior on their own labeled set.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Documented migration and evaluation walkthrough; no live API request, accuracy result, latency benchmark or cost measurement.
editorial_review.alternatives: Anthropic-managed Claude on Google Cloud remains a separate cloud-integration briefing. The MCP security release was published earlier today. Google has no newer qualifying API entry and SPECMEM remains research-only.
editorial_review.selection_rationale: A verified GA change within seven days adds a distinct implementation decision beyond the beta episode and is useful to builders already evaluating typed routing.
editorial_review.search_query: OpenAI Decisions API GA JSON input 400 questions migration
editorial_review.final_verdict: approved after source and archive review: the episode explains the GA-only delta, a concrete migration path and explicit no-live-test limits.
editorial_review.metadata_review: The title and description focus on the GA migration, link both primary sources, avoid repeating the beta headline and assign only the builder playlist.

playlist_review.reason: The complete episode answers a developer migration decision: new GA inputs, batching boundaries, evaluation thresholds and access limits.
